name: rkMethod
title: Collection of Parameter Sets (Butcher Arrays) for the Runge-Kutta Family of ODE Solvers

origin.description: Returns a list specifying coefficients and properties of ODE solver methods from the Runge-Kutta family.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: A string naming one of the pre-defined Runge-Kutta methods, such as euler, rk4, rk23bs (alias ode23), or rk45dp7 (alias ode45).
Fields of a user-defined solver or overrides for a pre-defined method.

origin.details: Without arguments, the names of all implemented Runge-Kutta methods are returned. With a method name, the Butcher table and metadata for that solver are returned. Additional arguments replace or add list elements and are checked for consistent stage lengths.
origin.value: Either a character vector of method names, or a list with class rkMethod containing ID, varstep, FSAL, A, b1, optional b2, c, optional d, densetype, stage, and Qerr.

translation.description: Returns a list specifying coefficients and properties of ODE solver methods from the Runge-Kutta family.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: A string naming one of the pre-defined Runge-Kutta methods, such as euler, rk4, rk23bs (alias ode23), or rk45dp7 (alias ode45).

arguments.name: **kwargs
arguments.text: Fields of a user-defined solver or overrides for a pre-defined method.

translation.details: Without arguments, the names of all implemented Runge-Kutta methods are returned. With a method name, the Butcher table and metadata for that solver are returned. Keyword arguments replace or add fields and are checked for consistent stage lengths.
translation.value: Either a MethodNames sequence, or an RkMethod mapping with ID, varstep, FSAL, A, optional b2, c, optional d, densetype, stage, and Qerr.
translation.example:
from deSolve.rkMethod import rkMethod

print(rkMethod())
print(rkMethod("rk45dp7"))
